title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing a degree in CS or related field; experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go.
description: Work on core product infrastructure and consumer-facing applications alongside experienced software engineers at Google.

title: Rhodes Scholarship for International Students
eligibility: Graduating undergraduate students and young professionals meeting constituency age requirements.
qualification: Completed Bachelor's degree with exceptional academic standing.
description: Fully funded postgraduate award supporting outstanding all-round students to study at the University of Oxford.

title: Junior Remote Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with strong fundamentals in modern web engineering.
qualification: Experience with HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript, and React.
description: Develop user-facing features for global web products like WordPress.com and WooCommerce in a fully distributed team environment.

title: Google Summer of Code (GSoC) Contributor
eligibility: Students and open-source development beginners aged 18 and older.
qualification: Familiarity with Git and programming languages relevant to open-source host organizations.
description: A global online mentorship program focused on bringing new contributors into open-source software development organizations.

title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with no prior programming experience required.
qualification: High school level mathematics or beginner interest in coding.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Associate Data Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of analytical experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline (CS, Statistics, Math, Economics).
description: Work with consulting teams to solve complex client issues through data modeling, statistical analysis, and dashboard design.
